definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that looks impressive, attractive, or admirable. Can refer to physical appearance, behavior, or style. Very common in spoken Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧、{格好|かっこう}いい⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{格好|かっこう}いい。
examples.english: He looks cool when he plays guitar.

examples.japanese: {格好|かっこう}いいこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧じゃ⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I don't just want you to say cool things — I want you to actually take action.

notes:
USAGE:
Often shortened to ⟦かっこいい→かっこいい：09378_kakkoii⟧ in casual speech and writing. The full form {格好|かっこう}いい is the standard dictionary form. Can describe people, objects, actions, and attitudes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格好|かっこう}いい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a cool/handsome person)
- {格好|かっこう}いい⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧ (a stylish design)
- {格好|かっこう}よく⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to make something look cool)

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {格好|かっこう}よく
- Negative: {格好|かっこう}よくない
- Past: {格好|かっこう}よかった

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧: cute — focuses on charm and endearment rather than cool impressiveness
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧: good-looking man — specifically for male physical attractiveness
- ⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧: fashionable — emphasizes fashion sense specifically
